responsibility: This file implements the playback side of libgccjit: the phase that turns recorded API objects into actual GCC tree nodes and drives compilation. It defines playback::context and the concrete creation/lowering routines for types, functions, globals, expressions, statements, source locations, diagnostics, and conversions; manages the active playback singleton and GC marking; interfaces with temp directories, builtin handling, GCC diagnostics, and source maps; and ultimately replays a recording context into GCC’s middle end and backend. It is the core lowering engine from libgccjit IR into GCC’s internal tree representation.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-playback.h, which declares the playback class hierarchy and APIs, this same-stem source file implements the replay engine that turns recorded JIT objects into GCC trees, handles diagnostics and locations, and drives compilation.
